title: Non-trivial work: lug with validated PEV contract required before showing user
rule: For any non-trivial new functionality discussion, a lug must be created with a complete PEV contract AND validated before being presented to the user.
trigger: Any discussion of new functionality that is not trivial (new feature, new skill, new advisor, new protocol behavior, architectural change)
required_before_show: perceive: points to real, findable files or clear observable state
execute: concrete steps — not vague intentions
verify: concrete done-state the user can confirm
Lug is self-contained — no 'see above' or conversation-dependent references
A naive agent could understand this without current conversation context
violation: Showing a lug draft and asking the user to help fill it in. Presenting incomplete PEV fields. Skipping validation.
rationale: User demands confidence the lug was improved before being shown. Incomplete lugs waste review time and break session continuity for future agents.
